items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Peggy Lee, Sarah Vaughan, Aretha Franklin -- Roberta Flack. [INTERVIEWEE] That's right. That's who it was.

ctx.x: Carol Burnett Show that wrote a quartet for Sarah Vaughan, Peggy Lee and Aretha Franklin and -- I forget the fourth singer. It's a name.
Peggy Lee, Sarah Vaughan, Aretha Franklin -- Roberta Flack.
That's right. That's who it was. And they wrote a great quartet.
